title: OutboxRecord
description: Row of a component's transactional outbox (AWS v1.7 s4.3, s13.2; Eng v1.4 s3 'consumers assume at-least-once delivery and must deduplicate'; Constitution #11). The normative table, inbox and grant layout is contracts/shared/sql/outbox.template.sql. Each component owns <schema>.outbox_event (tenant events) and <schema>.outbox_event_platform (events whose envelope tenant_id is null) in its own schema, inserts rows in the same transaction as its state change, and never updates them. A publisher process from packages/outbox (CMP-038) runs under the sf_outbox_publisher role, claims rows with a lease in one short transaction, publishes outside any transaction, and marks them in another. That role is the explicitly approved cross-tenant event service TI v1.0 s13 requires; it can read and update outbox tables only.

seq.description: Per-table publication order. Rows sharing a partition_key are published strictly in seq order.

tenant_id.description: Present in outbox_event (NOT NULL, RLS-enforced); absent in outbox_event_platform.

topic.description: Kafka topic name; must exist in the CMP-038 topic registry.

partition_key.description: The aggregate_id unless the topic registry declares another key for the topic.

envelope.description: The complete event as published. Validated against SF-CON-EVENT-ENVELOPE before insert; its event_id, tenant_id, event_type, schema_version and aggregate fields equal the row columns. At most 262144 bytes serialised.
